title: Pending interests not processed when updating treasury weight
summary: ## Severity  **Impact**: Medium, Can lead to loss of yield for the treasury or pool participants  **Likelihood**: Medium, loss only happens between the weight update and next deposit/withdrawal  ## Description  The function `setTreasuryWeights` sets the interest weight of the treasury and also updates the global `totalInterestWeight`.  ```solidity function setTreasuryWeights(     uint16 interestWeightTreasury_,     uint16 liquidationWeightTreasury_ ) external onlyOwner {     totalInterestWeight =         totalInterestWeight -         interestWeightTreasury +         interestWeightTreasury_; ``
